name: The Thickening
source:
This story takes place in an alternate reality where humanity is in the verge of extinction by a virus that killed all men, but made all women Thicc. You will play as the last human that was born on earth and experience a gigantic surprise.
Gigantic...
Surprise.​
translation:
这个故事发生在另一个现实中，人类正因一种病毒而濒临灭绝，这种病毒杀死了所有男性，却让所有女性都变得虚弱。你将扮演地球上最后一个出生的人类，体验巨大的惊喜。
巨大的…
惊喜。​
